info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Market Risk Models Retrieval API
info.description: The Market Risk Models Retrieval API enables users to access a comprehensive database of market risk models utilized within the banking sector. This endpoint serves as a vital resource for financial analysts and risk managers who need to evaluate and leverage analytical models for assessing market risks. By retrieving relevant models, users can make informed decisions to mitigate financial exposure and optimize their strategies. Ideal for integration within risk assessment tools or financial reporting systems, this API facilitates seamless access to critical financial data.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to retrieve a list of market risk models available in the system, providing insights into their characteristics and performance metrics.

requestBody.description: Request body to retrieve market risk models. This body is used to specify any filters or parameters needed for fetching the data. Ensure that the JSON structure adheres to the defined schema for accurate results.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the list of market risk models.

GetMarketRiskModelsRequest.description: A representation of the request body for the GET operation regarding market risk models.

GetMarketRiskModelsResponse_200.title: Market Risk Models Response

items.description: A list of market risk model objects.

sort.description: Sorting criteria applied to the list of models.

GetMarketRiskModelsResponse_200.description: A response object containing a list of market risk models and associated metadata.

MarketRiskModel.title: Market Risk Model
